newsitem.title: USA: Pacific stake lifted by Zweig-DiMenna.
newsitem.headline: Pacific stake lifted by Zweig-DiMenna.

text.p: A group including Zweig-DiMenna Partners L.P. said Tuesday it raised its stake in Pacific Sunwear of California Inc to 545,900 common shares, or to 6.8 percent from 5.6 percent.
In a filing with Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include buying 92,000 common shares between Jan 6 and 17 at $22.9961 to $23.375 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment.
Pacific Sunwear is a retailer of casual apparel, accessories and footwear for teenagers and young adults. It is based in Anaheim, Calif.
